capabilities: Color background and text of files and folders from a right-click menu
Adjust font weight, font style and opacity
Apply styles to subfolders and contained files
Style filenames by extension using an included CSS snippet
extras: Tested only with the default theme on Windows and Android; the README lists open bugs and future improvements, and community marketplace installation was not yet available at time of writing.
intentEvidence: a more robust, customizeable, plugin-based solution inspired by .css snippet applications
motivation: The author wants to provide "a more robust, customizeable, plugin-based solution" than CSS snippet applications.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer offers no per-item visual styling, so users resort to hand-written CSS snippets to highlight folders and files.

relations.evidence: Compatible with the Iconize plugin, which takes precedence
Designed to work with the Style Settings plugin

summary: File explorer appearance customizer that colors and styles individual folders and files via a right-click context menu with color pickers and presets.
